Along Highway 48, more than 6,000 people are building Rio Grande LNG, a project its developer values at about $30 billion. With global gas supply squeezed this year, buyers want every cargo, and that's why the work here doesn't stop.

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EHK9LqRBihU

Sources: RGV Business Journal, Apr-Aug 2026. Narration is AI-generated. Not financial advice.
